name: Akai Hitomi no Seraph
source:
Kengo and his lover Ai are in a relationship for two years, but they never were intimate with each other. Even when Kengo's parents go on a trip his suggestion is rejected by Ai. Kengo tried to summon a love angel with a spell, but failed with it. As a result, love of this world was confined and in order to save love he needs to enter the spirit world, interact with its inhabitants and rescue love withing a limited time period.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
贤吾与恋人爱交往已有两年，却从未有过亲密行为。即使贤吾父母外出旅行，爱的回答仍是拒绝。贤吾尝试用咒语召唤恋爱天使，却以失败告终，反而令整个世界的“爱”遭到封印。为了拯救爱情，他必须进入精灵世界，与当地居民交流，并在限定时间内救回“爱”。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
